decaying_aftermath.body.head: Head
decaying_aftermath.medical.apply_hint: Click item, release, then left/right-click a body part
decaying_aftermath.inventory.title: Medical inventory
decaying_aftermath.procedure.title: Medical procedure
decaying_aftermath.procedure.cancel: Esc: leave; used material is not restored
decaying_aftermath.procedure.guide.wrap: Grab the roll and wind clockwise. Multiple layers provide gradual bleed care. Keep winding; the percentage is remaining material.
decaying_aftermath.procedure.guide.syrin: LMB: align and insert the needle. Hold RMB for the plunger, then withdraw straight.
decaying_aftermath.procedure.guide.antis: Hold the bottle at the marker. Aim the nozzle inside the box and right-click to spray.
decaying_aftermath.procedure.guide.potio: LMB: bring the bottle to the wound. Mouse wheel: tilt; keep the pouring angle steady.
decaying_aftermath.procedure.guide.splin: Align the splint with both marks. Mouse wheel: rotate. Release to fit.
Thread each strap to the right, then pull it left to tension. Stay on the rail.
decaying_aftermath.procedure.guide.tourn: Place the tourniquet between the marks, then release.
Thread the strap to the right, then grasp the windlass and turn it clockwise three times.
decaying_aftermath.thought.supply_space: Need room for the unused items.
decaying_aftermath.hint.antibiotics: RMB: swallow. Controls infection; excess is toxic.
decaying_aftermath.hint.painkillers: RMB: swallow. Relieves pain; overdose risk.
decaying_aftermath.procedure.guide.tool: Drag the tool onto the marked game body region and hold steady. Esc cancels; completed extraction wears the tool once.
decaying_aftermath.report.vitals: Blood %s%%; O2 %s%%; water %s%%; nutrition %s%%; body %s C; load %s%%; red cells %s%%; plasma %s%%
decaying_aftermath.hint.naloxone: Use the medical panel. Blocks opioid effects.
decaying_aftermath.hint.blood_bag: Use the medical panel. Replaces blood.
decaying_aftermath.hint.saline: Use the medical panel. Replaces plasma.
decaying_aftermath.hint.ice_pack: Apply to burns or bruises. Not for frostbite.
decaying_aftermath.hint.chest_drain: Apply to the torso. Supports injured lung recovery.
decaying_aftermath.status.remove_splint: / splint: remove with the right-side button
decaying_aftermath.defib.not_needed: This device cannot be used on this patient.
decaying_aftermath.defib.cu_aed_guide: LMB: drag the pads as their pictures show. Release both, wait for analysis, then press the lightning button.
decaying_aftermath.defib.cu_manual_guide: LMB: turn the dial with your hand. The arrow button charges; the lightning button delivers the shock.
decaying_aftermath.pause.denied: There is no time to stop. Hold on.
decaying_aftermath.heal.done: Fully restored: injuries and conditions cleared.
decaying_aftermath.afterlife.thought.0: Where do thoughts go when there is nobody left to think them?
decaying_aftermath.afterlife.thought.1: Would anyone notice if I disappeared?
decaying_aftermath.afterlife.thought.2: I wanted everything to go quiet.
decaying_aftermath.afterlife.thought.3: I was tired of being here.
decaying_aftermath.afterlife.thought.4: Why did I feel so alone, even with other people?
decaying_aftermath.afterlife.thought.5: Is this all that will be left of me?
decaying_aftermath.afterlife.thought.6: I did not know how to ask for help.
decaying_aftermath.afterlife.thought.7: What if tomorrow could have been different?
decaying_aftermath.hint.antidepressants: RMB: take. Gradually treats melancholic, psychotic, and persistent depression; excess is toxic.
decaying_aftermath.hint.anxiolytic: RMB: take. Rapidly relieves acute panic and psychotic features; causes drowsiness.
decaying_aftermath.hint.herbal_tea: RMB: drink. Hydrates, calms, and gently lifts mood.
decaying_aftermath.thought.depression.si: Everything feels overwhelming... I need somewhere safe.
decaying_aftermath.thought.depression.se: Too dark for too long... I miss the daylight.
decaying_aftermath.thought.depression.me: Nothing brings relief anymore... everything feels hollow.
decaying_aftermath.thought.depression.ps: Shadows and whispers won't stop... I need to calm down.
decaying_aftermath.thought.depression.pe: This grey weight has lingered for far too long.
